payload.summary: Roadmap headline (Jim, chat 2026-07-30): nahel works on a repo whose code lives somewhere else than the nahel state. Example: code in ~/projects/cool-app-a, nahel state in ~/projects/nahel-projects/cool-app-a. nahel always knows where the real code is and creates worktrees etc. against it. State lives in its own separate GitHub repo; someone checking out cool-app-a without the sibling state repo loses the nahel info — Jim explicitly accepts that tradeoff.
